title_en: Woot Has a Grade A Refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 Available for $449, Which Is $50 Less Than Paying Full Price for the Console After Its Price Hike
summary_en: Woot has a Grade A refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 available for $449 for a limited time. Compared to paying full price for a brand new console now post-price hike, you're saving $50 through this offer.
body_en:
Woot (an online retailer owned and operated by Amazon) has a Grade A refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 console available to buy right now for $449, which is $50 cheaper than the console's brand new list price of $499.99 after the recent price hike . If you don't mind buying a refurbished model, it's quite a nice offer to take advantage of, especially if you're hoping to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake in November or explore the game deals in the upcoming Switch sale .
This console offer won't be around for long, though. Woot's store page says that there's just 15 days left to take advantage of it, or it's available until it's sold out, which could happen at any point. So, if you're really hoping to grab it, now is your chance.
And if you're curious what exactly 'Grade A Refurbished' means, Woot's store page says: "This item has been inspected and guaranteed to have minimal cosmetic damage & has successfully passed a full diagnostic test which ensures like-new functionality & removal of any prior-user's personal information." It also adds that, "Unit includes OEM accessories and is packaged in a generic white or brown box."
Before the console's recent price increase kicked in, we did spot this same console offer at Woot for $399.99 , but that was also a $50 difference in cost compared to the Switch 2's previous full price of $449.99. So overall, this remains quite a nice offer to jump on for a refurbished model. Again, it won't be around for long, and we may not see a console offer like it until Black Friday or Cyber Monday , so this is as good a time as any to grab it.
If you're hoping to find even more Nintendo deals, make sure to mark your calendar for the upcoming 'Customer Appreciation' sale , which starts on September 13 and runs through September 26. This will include 30% off Switch games and much more, so it'll be worth having a look at. Especially if you pick up this console, it'll be a great time to grab some new games for your library.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the guides and commerce teams here at IGN.
